result.brief: X-World 1.6 提出可控多相机驾驶世界模型，支持交通语义与2D/3D参考条件、单图生成多相机未来视频，并通过后训练实现少步因果长时序生成与专用评测。
result.reason: Action-conditioned multi-camera driving world model with controllable traffic semantics, long-rollout temporal coherence and few-step causal generation; directly a video world model contribution.
